title: Code Verification
description: A centred sign-in step that asks for a six-digit email code, with one native input drawn as six cells.
summary: OTP entry with resend and change-email paths.
notes: The code is a single input with autocomplete="one-time-code", so paste, autofill and password managers work without JavaScript. The six cells are decorative spans; keep their count equal to maxlength and the pattern.
Nothing is sent or checked here. Code delivery, expiry, rate-limited resends and error messages belong to your authentication service.
inputmode="numeric" only requests a numeric keyboard; validate the submitted value on the server.
